Huffman will oversee RTX's global technology strategy and lead new infrastructure developments to ensure security, speed and scalability as the platform continues to grow.

S&P 500's GE Aerospace Is IBD Stock Of The Day, In Buy Zone Following Recent Earnings
data.summary: GE Aerospace is Monday's IBD Stock Of The Day, as the S&P 500 component continues to show signs of strength coming out of earnings last week with several price target hikes Monday.  Last week, GE Aerospace beat third-quarter expectations, and the stock hit record highs, as it reported a 44% increase in earnings while revenue jumped 26%.  GE Aerospace makes and collaborates on various propulsion technologies that are utilized in missile engines.

data.headline: Airspace and Procedure Design Industry Research Report 2025-2033 Featuring Adacel, Leonardo, Frequentis, Advanced Navigation and Positioning, Honeywell, L3Harris, Indra Sistemas, RTX, Saab, THALES
data.summary: The global Airspace and Procedure Design Market is set to grow from $9.25 billion in 2024 to $15.59 billion by 2033, with a CAGR of 5.97% from 2025-2033. This expansion is driven by increasing air traffic, the need for optimized flight routes, and the adoption of advanced navigation technologies. The market focuses on enhancing fuel efficiency, safety, and modernization of airspaces worldwide. Key regions include North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, and the Middle East and Africa.
